app.title: Install {system}
app.subtitle: From your browser, over a USB cable.

door.title: What are you doing?
door.firstHint: The device runs something else, or nothing yet.
door.updateHintOwn: What is in the file is already on this device.

gate.insecure: This page has to be opened over a secure (https) address before it can talk to a device.
gate.noSerial: This browser cannot talk to a device over a cable. Use Chrome or Edge on a computer. A phone will not do.
gate.altFirst: You can still install from a terminal window:

action.backup: Save a copy of what is on the device first (about {minutes} min)
action.chooseBackup: Choose the copy you just saved
action.chooseBackupTitle: Now choose the copy you just saved
action.chooseBackupHint: Your browser saved it as {file}, usually in the Downloads folder.
action.erase: Clear everything on the device before installing

stage.matching: Choosing the right version for this device
stage.backup: Saving a copy of the device
stage.writing: Writing to the device, part {n} of {total}
stage.md5: Checking that everything was written correctly

prepare.title: Plug the device into this computer with a USB cable.
prepare.hintCable: Use a cable that came with a phone or camera. Some thin cables only charge and carry no data.
prepare.hintDoor: If you are not sure, choose First installation. It is always safe.
prepare.hintBackup: A copy lets you put the device back exactly as it was. It takes a few minutes and is optional.
prepare.picker: After you click, your browser opens a small window asking which device to use. Choose the one that appeared when you plugged in the cable.

install.keepCable: Keep the cable connected until this finishes.

backup.save: The copy is ready. Choose where to keep it, then the installation continues.
backup.saved: Saved as {file}. Checking it can be read back.

done.title: All done.
done.unplug: You can unplug the cable now.

wifi.title: Connect the device to Wi-Fi
wifi.hint: The device can take your network details now, so you do not have to set it up by hand.
wifi.ok: The device is on your network.
wifi.open: Open the device in your browser

own.title: Install your own file
own.hint: Choose a file from this computer. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
own.url: Or give the address of a file
own.urlHint: Paste a link to a file on this site, or anywhere that allows it.
own.appHint: Keeps what is on the device and updates the program.
own.address: Where on the device it goes
own.plan: {name} goes to {address} on {device}. The installer stops if the connected device turns out to be a different one.
own.unknownDevice: The file does not say which device it is for. Choose it above. The installer stops if the connected device turns out to be a different one.
own.badAddress: The address has to start with 0x and be a multiple of 0x1000, for example 0x10000.

pick.title: Choose a system
pick.hint: Pick what you want to put on your device.

erase.title: Erase everything on the device?
erase.textFirst: This will erase everything on {board}, including saved Wi-Fi and settings, and install a fresh copy.
erase.textUpdate: Erasing also removes saved settings. You can keep them.
erase.hint: Erasing removes saved Wi-Fi and settings from the device. The system you are installing goes on fresh. Your copy from the previous step, if you made one, is not affected.

board.pickHint: We found {chip} with {flash} of flash. {count} builds fit it. Pick yours.

error.manifest.url: The address of the release file is not valid. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.notObject: The release file is not valid. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.schema: The release file is written in a format this installer does not know ({schema}). This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.name: The release file does not say which system it installs. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.version: The release file does not say which version it is. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.noBuilds: The release file offers nothing to install. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.build: Entry {index} of the release file is not valid. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.boardKey: Entry {index} of the release file has an invalid name. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.chipFamily: Build {boardKey} names a device this installer does not know ({chipFamily}). This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.profile: Build {boardKey} asks for a way of installing this installer does not know. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.preserveNoErase: Build {boardKey} asks to clear the whole device, which is not allowed when settings have to be kept. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.flashSizeMB: Build {boardKey} states an invalid memory size. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.usb: Build {boardKey} states invalid USB identifiers. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.filters: Build {boardKey} has invalid matching rules. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.compatibility: Build {boardKey} has invalid compatibility data. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.noParts: Build {boardKey} has no files to install. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.part: Build {boardKey}, file {index} is not valid. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.path: One of the files in the release has no location to download from. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.origin: The release points to another site ({origin}), and files have to come from this site. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.offset: Build {boardKey}, file {index} has an invalid address. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.size: Build {boardKey}, file {index} has an invalid size. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.sha256: Build {boardKey}, file {index} has an invalid checksum. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.preserveNeedsSize: Build {boardKey}, file {index} needs both a size and a checksum. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.duplicateBoardKey: Two builds in the release file share the name {boardKey}. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.manifest.improv: Build {boardKey} has an invalid Wi-Fi setup flag. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.improv.timeout: The device did not answer in time. Check that it is still connected, then try again.
error.improv.rejected: The device refused the network details. Check the network name, then try again.
error.improv.wifi: The device could not join that network. Check the password and try again.
error.manifest.fetch: Could not download the release file ({status}). Check your connection and try again. If it keeps failing, the release itself is broken, not your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.catalog.fetch: Could not load the list of systems. Check your connection and try again. If it keeps failing, this page is broken, not your device. Tell whoever runs it.
error.catalog.unknownSystem: There is no system called {fw} here. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.catalog.unknownVersion: This version of {fw} is not available here. This is a problem with the release itself, not with your device. Tell whoever published it.
error.verify.empty: One of the release files is empty. Nothing was written, so your device is unchanged. Try again, and tell whoever published this release if it happens again.
error.verify.part: One of the release files is not usable. Nothing was written, so your device is unchanged. Try again, and tell whoever published this release if it happens again.
error.verify.tooLarge: The file {path} is larger than this installer allows. Nothing was written. Tell whoever published this release.
error.verify.size: The file {path} arrived with {bytes} bytes instead of {expected}. The download was stopped and nothing was written. Check your connection and try again.
error.verify.sha256: The file {path} does not match the release and may have been damaged on the way. Nothing was written. Check your connection and try again.
error.verify.overlap: Two files in this release want the same place on the device. Nothing was written. Tell whoever published this release.
error.verify.beyondFlash: This release needs more memory than this device has. Nothing was written. Check that you picked the right system for your device.
error.verify.totalTooLarge: This release is larger than this installer allows. Nothing was written. Tell whoever published this release.
error.verify.notAnImage: The file for address 0x{offset} is not a program this device can start. Nothing was written. Tell whoever published this release.
error.verify.wrongChip: These files are made for a different device ({found}), not {expected}. Nothing was written. Check that you picked the right system for your device.
error.verify.flashSize: The size of the device's memory could not be determined. Nothing was written. Unplug the device, plug it back in and try again.
error.verify.chipUnknown: This device's chip is not one this installer knows. Nothing was written. Check that you picked the right system for your device.
error.serial.cancelled: No device was chosen. Start again and pick your device from the list the browser shows.
error.serial.busy: The port is in use. Close the Arduino IDE, serial monitors or other flashing tools, then try again.
error.serial.lost: The device was disconnected. Plug it back in and try again.
error.serial.connect: The device did not answer. Try again, and on some boards hold the BOOT button while you connect.
error.serial.blocked: The browser did not allow access to the device. Reload the page and choose Allow when asked.
error.device.chipUnknown: The device did not say what it is. Unplug it, plug it back in and try again.
error.device.flashUnknown: The size of the device's memory could not be read reliably (id 0x{id}). Nothing was written. Try another cable or another USB port.
error.device.noMatch: This release is not made for this device. Yours has a {chip} chip with {flash} of memory. Check that you picked the right system for your device.
error.device.changed: A different device is connected now. Start again with the device you want to install on.
error.device.secured: This device is locked by its maker (secure boot or encrypted flash), so nothing was written. Use the tools from the device's maker instead.
error.device.layout: This device's memory is arranged differently from the one this release was tested on. Nothing was written. Tell whoever published this release.
error.device.notEmpty: The area this release needs is already in use. Nothing was written. Choose First installation to clear the device and start fresh.
error.backup.mismatch: The copy was read twice and the two reads differ. Nothing was written. Try again, ideally with a shorter cable.
error.backup.file: The chosen file is not a copy of this device. Choose the copy you saved from this device, or start again without one.
error.flash.erase: The device could not be cleared. Nothing was written. Reconnect the device and try again.
error.flash.write: Writing stopped part way. Reconnect the device and try again. Do not erase the device by hand.
error.flash.verify: What is on the device does not match the release. Keep your copy and try again.
error.engine.load: The part of this page that talks to devices could not be loaded. Reload the page and try again.
error.engine.busy: Something else is still running. Wait for it to finish and try again.
error.engine.unexpected: Something unexpected stopped the installer before anything was written. Reload the page and try again.
error.own.blocked: This browser may not read that address from this page. Download the file and choose it from your computer instead.
